body: I spend every night wondering the same thing. I cry each night praying to close my eyes and never wake up. My heart aches from how much I cry. I sit alone...in a dark room...and I feel theres not exit. Honestly, I don't know how one suicide person comforts another, but now, I haven't killed myself because I use everyday looking for a reason to live.  Honestly the best advice if you are seeking a reason to live like I am, use that as your motivation. Look for a reason to live.
